domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the first-order signature, variable type, finite input representation, substitution representation and composition convention, and equality notion on terms and substitutions.
conclusion: Open: the repository gloss does not choose termination, soundness, success completeness, failure correctness, most-generality, or a conjunction of these properties.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet frozen. Empty equation systems, variable-only and ground terms, cyclic equations such as x = f(x), signatures without function symbols, substitution extensionality, and finite-support requirements depend on the selected theorem.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory is the intended backend; classical choice, decidable equality, quotient, and finiteness requirements remain open until an exact algorithm and theorem are selected
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, executable implementation, and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No unifier implementation, evaluator, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; an eventual executable algorithm must be proof-producing or have its result replayed by the kernel
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, algorithm or correctness claim, term/substitution representation, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Pinned term and substitution APIs elaborate, but no exact source theorem, algorithm, or canonical Lean target is selected. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
